title: ProviderConfig
description: Configuration of a generation destination. Credentials are never stored here; `credential_ref` names an entry in the OS credential store.

allow_failover.description: Whether this destination may be used automatically when the preferred one fails.

declared_tier.description: Tier the owner declared. The runtime tier may be lower (e.g. a NEAR model whose attestation is not verified is treated as EXTERNAL_UNVERIFIED).

default_model.description: Default model sent upstream when the client's model is not served here.

supports_responses.description: Whether the upstream natively supports `/v1/responses`. If false, Prompt VPN translates Responses requests into Chat Completions.

DestinationTier.description: Privacy tier of a generation destination.

oneOf.description: Remote, with attestation verified for the exact model and service.
Any other remote endpoint, including NEAR models without verified TEE.
